notes.title: Snow • Fall Patch Notes - Version 0.2 (Egoist)
notes.content:
[i]"No matter how much time passes, my suffering will not be erased."[/i]


[b]Additions[/b]
-Added 13 new Products (+8)
-Added 18 new Cubes
-Added 4 new Dreams
-Added 9 new Goals
-Added 2 new Reminiscent Mode exclusive enemies, Collective EGD Students.
-Reminiscent Mode Runs are now automatically saved upon the start of a new Node, and can be continued at any time
-Settings is now split up into two submenus, "Audio & Resolution," and "Gameplay." Within Gameplay you will find three setting: Phase Skip, Screen Shake, and Auto Battle. Let me know what you think about Auto Battle, I'm not quite sure if the speed is right.
-The Product List in the pause menu can now be scrolled through using the mouse wheel
-Different game modes now have Product Pools. For most of you, this won't mean anything, but most achievement items (and items from post launch updates) are now unable to be found in Mika Side Story - Severance.


[b]Changes [/b]

-Disk 4 has been capped at 3 times per turn
-Coeur D'enfant no longer gives Tilt
-Alice Shot Dagger's Cooldown has been increased to 6 turns
-Disk 10 now only reduces the Minimum Droplet roll by 1
-Zhu Haoyu's "On Standby" now only gives 1 Power Up
-Slightly reduced the rolls of Zhu Haoyu's "On Standby"
-Changed the Droplet effects of Gravedigger's "Azure Vivisepulture"
-The Purchasing Staff have been reduced to REM Level 1, meaning they'll appear earlier in Reminiscent runs
-Product Naivety has been renamed to Amai to fit with other Station Tears Products
-Changed the Cube Art for Poor Soul and Your Reflection
-Certain Dream specific passives are now highlighted in red
-The volume of certain sound effects have been toned down
-Increased the scroll area for decks


[b]Bug • Fixes[/b]

-Certain Products can no longer activate using data from previous fights
-Fixed certain crashes regarding the Alzuru Station Personnel's Storage
-Fixed various bugs regarding the Jingzi Bamboo Product
-Fixed a bug in which Gravedigger's Phantom Damage could sometimes cancel Cube or Product Effects
-Fixed a bug in which Products that increased Max HP would not add the new HP
-Fixed a bug in which Misery Gravedigger's Achievement Unlock Passive would not activate
-Fixed (and probably introduced) typos within various parts of the game
-Fixed an oversight in which certain Collective Passives were tagged as Station Passives
-Fixed a bug in which the enemy attempting to use Positive/Negative Slush could result in a crash
-Fixed a bug in which transitions between screens could sometimes happen far too fast

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey, hello, and hi hi! It is I, flower baasket. Today, I have come with a roadmap!

I'm not leaving this game to die, I would never! As long as people are interested, I'll work until my dying breath...! 

With more immediate news, there's gonna be another patch tomorrow (or, later today, I guess), and it'll introduce the very nice change of increasing the maximum hand size to 8! Ya'll are gonna have to tell me how that goes, hopefully this incentivizes more interesting builds.

Some Products will also be receiving fairly harsh nerfs, specifically those without caps. Discard & Burn will not survive the upcoming winter.

But for now, I don't have much else to say, so let's just get into it.

[h1]Snow • Fall - Early Access Version 0.2 - EGOIST [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/1fdbb428bd28539441c5dd92e31c132853e6176c.png[/img]

Here we have the first planned update for Snow • Fall, Egoist! Along with featuring a new fightable faction, this will come with many new Products!

While the main purpose of this update is to add more content to Reminiscent Mode, this will also come with a lot of requested features, such as an auto-roll setting and the ability to skip the first space-bar press. And more importantly, the ability to save runs that aren't Dreams! Woo!

Also comes with a new Core Status, that's very exciting! It's a Negative Ailment that makes it more likely for the inflicted to roll minimum. It's called Sentiment. 

Items will be mostly centered around Sentiment, Discard, Positive/Negative Slush, and Emotions, with some others on the side. 

[h1]Snow • Fall - Early Access Version 0.3 - Fragile [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/221ece1d22bb442724150bd490e5a72dab6a89d2.png[/img]

And the second, Fragile!

The most important thing to notice here is the brand new Droplet Type. Not to spoil too much, but I currently only have a name for them: Taunt Droplets.

No word on the themes of the Products or Cubes or anything, but a lot of the new Cubes will feature Taunt Droplets. 


[h1]Snow • Fall - Early Access Version 0.4 - Prudence [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/316da56def771eafb5202a7e9852ec666959e758.png[/img]

Wahaha! Instead of another Mika Side Story, we're gonna pivot to the middle Liu sibling, Liu Griffn!

After the events of Severance, Griffn got a request to investigate the newly opened Kisaragi Station. Located in the middle of the Forbidden District, a city with almost no human occupants. Being strung along by the Station Founder, she'll have to learn that "there are so many things that you can't understand."

No ETA on this, as you may have noticed. I'm hoping the gap between this and 0.3 won't be too long, but who knows? I'm really excited to share this one! Currently, it's planned to be shorter than Severance, but will come with more variety. Less repeat enemies, more unique sprites, etc.

Thankfully, once 0.2 finishes up, I'll be able to work on this on the side. I've already wrote a couple of cutscenes. Don't take my word on this, but I'm guessing very late 2025 or early 2026. Most likely  2026.

And that should be about it for 2025 and early 2026. Hears hoping for a successful future!

notes.title: Q & A
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]


Hello, hello, and hi, welcome to July, with yours truly, flower baasket! Lord, has it been a long month...It's been so long we couldn't even afford the • in the announcement title...

Let me tell you, bug testing is not fun! Terrible, terrible, I had to spend so much time fixing shit I never woulda thought of. Doesn't help that even if somebody catches a bug, that doesn't make it easy to replicate. Eugh.

Anyway, anyway, it's not all bad. Because the game is gonna release in a month! Yippee!

As a little treat I have two new videos for you. Coming soon! Sorry...

I couldn't finish them in time. It just wouldn't feel right without adding this one thing. I've been waiting on this one person to get back to be, but once they do I'll get that out as fast as I can!

I'll make another Steam post (or maybe update this one) once I end up finishing that. Hopefully before the end of July. 

Now is a good time to advertise [url=https://www.youtube.com/@fruitbowll7575]my YouTube account[/url], because it'll be posted there first!

But yeah! Since the game's coming out soon, I thought I'd detail a bunch of information about the launch here. Of course, if you have any questions, I'd be happy to personally answer them. I hope I can meet your expectations with this!

[h1]Q •  A[/h1]

Ah, there's the dot. Right, let's get on with it!

[h2]How much will the game cost?[/h2]

Might as well start with something simple. Yes, I am charging for this game, but not very much.

[b]Snow •  Fall at launch will cost $4.99. It'll be 20% off the first week[/b] though, so only $4.00 if you buy fast!

Or wait to buy it, I don't care. More money for me!


[h2]How much content is currently in the game?[/h2]

If you want a simple answer, it's enough content to be worth $5, I believe. But if you're more of a numbers person, I got the numbers for you right here.

[b]1 Side Story[/b] (~1 Hour and 30 minutes without skipping dialogue) 
[b]8 Challenges[/b]
[b]1 Infinite Mode[/b]
49 Items (17 Unlockables, [b]total of 66[/b])
49 Cubes/Cards (22 Unlockables, [b]total of 71[/b])
[b]38 Steam Achievements[/b]
3 Characters (each with one variant,[b] total of 6[/b])


It's hard to put a number on a game like this, since it was designed around getting all the achievements. However, I will say that my acquaintance has 12.1 hours on the game as of writing, and is missing one achievement.

...Granted, they did also abuse a bunch of bugs and OP items, so it might take you even longer. Or even less time, who knows.

Just take that with a grain of salt, but you'll have a fair amount of content. At least until I can get an update out.

[h2]Difficulty?[/h2]

Hm...now that I've had somebody play it, I can say this with certainty. This might be a bit strange, considering where this game comes from, but...

[b]...this game is kinda easy.
[/b]
There are parts where I believe some players will get tripped up (looking at you, painter), but I think the difficulty for this game is fairly low.

[b]I don't plan for it to be easy forever[/b], it's just because I didn't go too crazy with the fights in this Side Story. Of course, as the first ever Side Story, I wanted it to be kind of chill in that regard.

Sorry if you're disappointed by that. You'll get your difficulty spike soon. Heavy emphasis on the soon.


[h2]What is the tone of the story?[/h2]

I've said this before, but I don't think I'm a very good writer. Though, I think this game is fun to read.

There's still some angst in the ending cutscenes of the Side Story and in some of the implied lore, but this game is very silly. 

If you've been reading the Steam posts, you'll know exactly what type of writing to expect from this game. 

[h2]How hard is this game to run?[/h2]

[b]Not very.
[/b]
If you're worried about if you can run this game, don't be! 

My computer, which I consider to be fairly mediocre, runs this game perfectly fine! Even when recording, it doesn't give me many issues. 


[h2]Who cares, when is the game releasing?[/h2]

[b]LATE AUGUST ! ! !
[/b]

More details will be posted once we get closer, but that's the ETA as of right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/fe1f14d90a3bec01d4af43b8a15449268808481b.png[/img]

Thank you very much, everyone! I hope this will be a wonderful launch!

notes.title: Beautiful • June.
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]

Hello, hello, hey, and hi, it is I, flower baasket, here for the 6th monthly Snow • Fall devlog.

Unlike usual, I'm not going to go over percentages, I'm just gonna go over the important stuff. Which, to be honest, there isn't much. Well, besides that one thing, but we'll get to that.

I'm just gonna start by saying that [b]everything (except that HORRID UI) is finished.[/b] [b]Challenges done, Achievements done, I'm pretty sure the game can be played from start to finish right now.[/b] 

Though, I'm gonna have to be on the lookout for any bugs. Which is exactly why the game is being playtested on the exact day that this post goes live. Yippee!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/41ec332a085facfafc6e7f60dd2aece8a5f30cc1.png[/img]

So yeah, not really much to say. I'll just highlight the important stuff.


[h1]RUSSIAN • TRANSLATIONS ! ! !
[/h1]

...What a coincidence. Here's the important stuff.

Tell all your Russian friends, and tell them to wishlist this game, too, because [b]Snow • Fall is getting Russian translations![/b]

It's incredible, honestly. For somebody to care enough about this admittedly amateurish-looking game to the point where they'd want to translate it. Truly, even if this game flops hard, these are experiences I wouldn't trade for the world.

There is [b]a very slim chance that it's going to be in the game at launch, though.[/b] I mean, it might be possible, but I have to change so much stuff around because the game hardcoded in English.

But, you never know, we'll see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/69149759809583bc78bb07f80b12cfc6135173ea.gif[/img]

God, it's so fucking cool! As you can see, it's not at all finished, but all of the passives have been properly translated.

Can't wait for the British English translation next! 

[h1]Cutscene • Redo [/h1]

With the game being translated, now is a wonderful time to put any finishing touches I have on cutscenes. And I'm doing just that.

I'm very aware that I'm not a good writer, but from what I heard from the last playtester, it was at least fun to read, and honestly, that's what matters the most.

But yeah, just [b]adding more to some of those rushed scenes, and polishing it up for the greatest impact![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/bf577497fb0b1d40793a474285c06afe94068347.png[/img]


[h1]End
[/h1]

Huh, that really was a short devlog...I really only made this to show off the Russian translations, and to show that the game is still being worked on!

For my next steps, I'll be working on finishing up the new text system, and polishing up those screens that I feel could look a bit better. Strange, even though the game's basically done, it feels as if I have so much work to do...

[b]Oh, and I'll definitely have another trailer by the end of next month![/b] Most of the Steam Page is a bit outdated, so I'd like to update that. 

Well, that'll be all for this month. I wish you all a good rest of your day, and a very Beautiful June. Until next time!

notes.title: Love • (Greif)
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]

Hello, (hello), greetings, and hi! It is I, flower baasket, here for the May devlog of Snow • Fall. Stick around for the Opening Statements, they're actually important this time.

As Snow • Fall comes closer to completion, it's plainly obvious that I...simply am running out of interesting things to detail in these devlogs. It's kinda scary how close we are to release.

[b]What this means is that the future devlogs will most likely get shorter in length, and probably will change in format.[/b] I was thinking about highlighting some item synergies in the next one, since I haven't talked about gameplay in any of these posts. But who knows, I’m always open to suggestions.

I hope you'll stick around for that! It truly makes me happy to see that other people actually care about a project like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/a93598f6497df1c6a125d16d9dc850078f59d90c.png[/img]

With all that out of the way, let's get straight into the progress!

[h1]Reminiscent • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]100% - Good night, my sweet prince...[/h2]

Reminiscent Mode is fully complete. Never thought I'd see the day.

And with it comes [b]the final faction for release: Station Ai Research Subjects![/b] Originally, the second member was just supposed to have a gray uniform, but I read a comment about body horror, and that sounded a lot more memorable! So, here we have it: A school student, and an Emotionbound! What’s an Emotionbound? I’m not explaining it, that’s what you buy the game for.

The cool-looking one is called Heart Cas(t)ing! Even I’m not sure how to pronounce that…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/44e95c49582311ed43cef5a53958382cabc0f01d.gif[/img]

They fight using their student handbag, following the command of the necklace. I don't actually know how to describe their decks, and I think "fodder" is the most fitting term.

Balancing, balancing…I guess that’s really all that’s left for this game mode. [b]I’ll get to play-testing posthaste![/b]

The final thing I have to do is UI work. What a cruel twist of fate…

Well, to start off with something exciting, [b]look at this! We got character portraits now! Woo! Exciting! [/b]Still working out some kinks, but I'm pretty happy with it right now. Done by Kokoax_o, who also did the art in the opening statements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/4969d8bdbf3fc2c2d70b33b448af24e207042d01.png[/img]

On the bright side, [b]new zoom feature…and new Station page in the item manual...hehe…
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/9d16b62ad1b3b0f2f6003270a9bfcefb7271c94f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/7377fd5ca3a688fc90b9076739424f05a21224dd.png[/img]

...Is that all for this devlog? I suppose so...I think this is the shortest one yet.

Wish I had more to say, but that's it! Like I said, things are gonna get shorter, and I guess this is proof. 

Thank you very much for reading, and I'll see you in the next devlog!

notes.title: A • UI • Update • In • Which • Nothing • But • UI • Work • Was • Done
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]

Hey, hello, and hi, it is I, flower baasket here. Bet you'll never guess what this Steam Post is gonna focus on. Truly, it’s exciting.

But, before that, I usually like to take this time to talk about music, and this post is no exception. But, it's not exactly just a song this time. This month, I saw the Project Sekai movie in theaters. My thoughts? Well, if you've played ProSekai, it's an absolute treat. Long rambling incoming.

Let me start this off by saying that I'm not even the biggest fan of the game. Sure, I'll log on every once in a while, maybe read a story or two, but I don't play often. I watched all of Nightcord, the introduction of WxS, then promptly dropped it. Only picked it up a week before the movie released so I could catch up on the lore.

And I still loved it. Seeing all the characters interact and Vocaloid references was so fun, I especially love the theater reaction. Some people came dressed as Ren and Lin, people were hyped up from the back to back performances at the end, it was wonderful, everyone there was as much of a nerd as I was. And nobody was overdoing it, either, it was one of the best theater experiences I've gone to.

Special shoutout to Tsukasa, who I came dressed as. Guy was clip farming in every scene he was in. I'm already seeing videos of his reactions, he truly was a star. DECO*27 and crew cooked with the six songs, this movie is going to live rent-free in my head for months. Come to streaming, or re-run the movie, I need to watch it again.

...But I suppose that's enough rambling for now. Don't leave me to my own devices, or this post will be 90% Project Sekai. I'm moving on while I still have the chance.

We have...actually some pretty interesting things to go over this month. If I did nothing but UI work, I'd probably go insane, so there's a little bit of everything here. 

[h1]Story • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]101% - Fully fully complete![/h2]

...Starting off with something that I finished as early as devlog 1, the story! For testing reasons, I was going to publish a playable build of the game on Steam, so I decided to playthrough the first chapter to make sure that there weren't any game breaking bugs or anything. [b]I Played through the story about three times, and I was pleasantly surprised with the results. 
[/b]
[b]It takes about an hour to complete (while I skipping the dialogue), sometimes longer depending on the items I got.[/b] If that doesn't sound like a long time, keep in mind that this game's gonna be like $4 on release. And there's more to do, ya know!

I ended up polishing up some stuff, [b]giving a new sprite to one of the units (it's basically a reskin, but better than nothing), and, at the request of some of my close friends, added 4 new items.[/b] There's still some jank elements that I'd like to fix before release, but I'm chalking that up to the UI, and not the mode itself. So, once again, we're done, and better than ever.

I'm putting a cap on adding new content to the game. I know I really should have done that earlier, but adding 1-3 new items isn't that difficult, especially since the base for everything is practically done already. An hour long detour never hurt nobody.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/a302f30682bcd51c83cf57ad4d6e8a2475ccc6f4.png[/img]

[h1]Reminiscent • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]90% - Almost Done![/h2]

...I knew I said I wouldn't do anything with this mode until the end of May, but my bad, I had a really good reason for that, I swear.

I kept thinking of which faction would be the 2nd one to come on release, and I had some really good enemies. Too many good enemies, actually. I'd design an entire deck, then think of another enemy, and this cycle would repeat, and now I'd be stuck between which one I liked the most. I designed 5 separate decks for 5 separate factions! In less than 2 weeks!

Obviously, if this continued, I'd have about 50 different factions to choose from when June rolled around, so I decided to just bite the bullet and stop stressing over it. And so, [b]here's the winner of the gauntlet: Station Ai Research Subjects!
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/a6311f9d1b2e31ff1c282f90eaeef724f464561d.png[/img]

School girls? School girls with necklaces!
 ...More interesting than it sounds, I assure you.

They aren't quite finished yet, the sprite for the 2nd enemy of this faction isn't even done, so I'll go into them more in the next devlog. Once they are finished, though, I'd like to have a couple of friends playtest the finished Reminiscent Mode. [b]If everything's good, then that means I can finally put a cap on Rem[/b], leaving me with nothing to do but balancing and UI changes.

With RemMode being almost completed, I would like to celebrate this occasion the only way I know how...by [strike]making a Discord Sever and giving out steam keys[/strike] giving myself more work. Everyone, give a warm welcome to the new progress category!

[h1]Misc • Progress
[/h1]
[h3]Achievements: 60% - No Progress [/h3]
[h3]Challenges: 10% - This game's gonna have challenges...? [/h3]
[h3]UI: 60% - Slow Progress. [/h3]

Challenges? Woah, nobody said anything about challenges? That's not even on the Steam Page!

Yes, challenges were always planned for the game, though at the time of making the Page, I was unsure of their addition, so I did not mention them. Until now, that is.

I dunno if I want to rename them to something more dream related to fit with the game's theming, but we're balling for now. Don't worry, [b]challenges were taken into consideration when estimating the game's release date[/b], so August still seems like a fairly reasonable task. 

[b]The game will be releasing with 8 different challenges, each of them giving an item as a completion reward. [/b]Think of Isaac challenges, they aren't designed to be difficult, but fun, unique runs that showcase the more interesting mechanics of Snow • Fall. Most of them aren't even full runs, actually...
As for their progress...I got nothing, sorry. I finished the challenge menu, but that's more of a UI thing. And speaking of UI things...

This is a UI post, how could I forget about that? That's right, a majority of the work for this month went towards finishing the awful looking or unfinished menus in the game. How did that turn out? Erm...[b]I...finished the achievements menu. And redid the death screen...and the challenge menu, but I already said that.[/b]

There are genuinely not enough words in the English lexicon to describe my distaste for designing menus. When it works, it works, and I'm satisfied, but when it doesn't, it leaves me feeling like shit. If the game gets delayed, the fault lies with UI. The character selection screen in particular is haunting me, I haven't even touched it for the past month, and that's because I have no idea what to do with it. Even now, I'm drawing blanks, I don't know how to make this look good.

I think I also finished the item encyclopedia menu? I'm very torn on it, I can't decide if it's fine or not, and I think that just means that it's missing something. I think I might have an idea on what to do with it, let's see if I can get it done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/fae6b82fe7b2203d0a97e83dbc09bc587a229975.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/037b2dc4cedb4268e14969a7d3e7421e45c870f6.png[/img]

Sorry, I don't have a lot unlocked, I'm very bad at this game :(

Thank you creasion616 for that Griffn art, by the way. Never got the chance to say this anywhere, but it wouldn't be the same game without them, they're an amazing artist, truly. Lucky to have them on board. 

Once again, now that everything is mostly finalized, let me restate: [b]Mika Side Story - Severance will be releasing with 50 base items (16 unlockable), 46 base Cubes (or cards, 21 unlockable), 8 challenges, an infinite mode, 34 achievements, and a ~hour and thirty minute long first chapter![/b] I really coded all that?!

It's incredible to see how far this has come, and I really hope I can keep going. This is the end of the devlog. Thank you for reading, and happy 21st!

notes.title: Cursive • 𝒜
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]

𝒜nother month, another steam post. Hello, hello, greetings, and hi! I'm shocked, another month flew by without me noticing. Honestly, that's gotta be some sort of record. Three months, and we're somehow not dead in the water. It's kind of shocking, honestly. But, speaking of things that were dead in the water: me!

I got hit with this horrible flu in the middle of the month, and I lost a week's worth of progress because I was just stuck recovering. It may not sound like a lot, but a month is only 4 weeks, and I spent one of those doing literally nothing!

I was going to listen to every song by Chinozo, but by the time I recovered I lost a lot of motivation and never ended up doing it. I listened to some good songs this month, though! Shout-out to Anti-You by Chinozo and RuLe by Ado. I think I really like rebellious themes, now that I'm looking back.

...And speaking of rebellious themes, Snow • Fall! Woo! Despite everything that happened, this is a very packed month, with a bunch of content to go over. Prepare for a long post, 𝒶nd let's get into the progress!

...Sorry. I'm done with the cursive 𝒜's. For now.

[h1]Reminiscent • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]80% - Progress Leap?!
[/h2]

I thought I said I was sick? How could I have possibly done 50% worth of work? Well, I might have overestimated how hard it would be to finish Reminiscent Mode. Fuck, it's basically done already.

[b]The two exclusive bosses have their decks done completed,[/b] I'm really just waiting a bit to add finishing touches to one of them. They might be a little bit underpowered for their level, but that's about it.

The Station Passives that I was talking about last devlog (go read it) got expanded upon, too. [b]Now each enemy has 4 unique Station Passives, but can only hold 2 at a time.[/b] There's also the universal passives, but it's the same deal, 2 at a time. Hopefully this makes it less predictable and more synergistic.

The looping mechanic was also finished! Did I ever mention that? Well, if I didn't, Reminiscent Mode is supposed to be nearly infinite, the run doesn't end unless you want it to. The system I decided on is that [b]after every 15 Nodes, players are given a choice to continue their run. If you pick yes, enemies will get a little buff,[/b] usually HP and damage related, then you'll go back to Node 0, and the process repeats.

That little feature forced my hand, let me tell you. I had to make a fodder item that shows up when you exhaust the item pool, which previously wasn't possible because the longest the game went on for before was only 18 Nodes. Breakfasting in Snow • Fall is real now. Not that you should be looping that many times anyway, seriously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/d5bf74b98695ee678965b28eb21bd5f15fb2ad2b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/2cde0d2c39fdd4f807c111354a3d8feea04eafe1.png[/img]

I think Mind's End Piece is a really cool looking item. Too bad most players will probably never see it. And the item sucks, too, so there's that.

The second most notable thing is that [b]1/2 of the Reminiscent exclusive enemies have been completed![/b] Well, technically, it's 2 enemies, just from 1 faction. That's more so what I mean.

𝒜lzuru Station Personnel, they're quite the rebellious bunch, choosing to ignore any sort of conventional "rules." They use transforming dagger-bows to open the Pale Void, a place of infinite storage which lets them store cards and negative status effects inside of it. Anything in their storage cannot be accessed, which is very bad when it comes to cards, but very useful when it comes to negative status effects. [b]Their decks center around harming themselves for massive pay-offs.[/b] They can do some pretty big damage if you let them set up, so they make for a pretty dangerous fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/ef4cbb9c5754a045c62ac7455ced3850f93b7337.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/e58cb49ecf0d22c1cf6fdb41bdd67abc12edbf34.png[/img]

Look at them, aren't they just adorable? They look all innocent, but they [i]will[/i] kick your ass. And yes, that is technically their uniform. But no, they aren't required to wear it, that would be a stupid "rule." And no, there is no male uniform. The men also wear dresses, because gender norms, too, are merely ignorable "rules."

Unfortunately, poor guys lost their eyes in the transition. Sorry, grunts don't get seeing privileges! 

I also prepared a video showcasing these guys off. It's got voice acting and everything. If you're interested in lore, or just wanna see gameplay footage, check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QnUzN2iWPa8

At this point, there's not much else I can do with the mode at the moment. I could finish up the Station Passives and those bosses, but besides that, I can't really do anything. The sprites for the 2nd faction probably won't be worked on until late May. [b]For now, Reminiscent Mode is almost complete, and will probably stay at around 80-90% for a while!
[/b]

[h1]Misc • Progress
[/h1]
[h3]Achievements: 60% - Rewards are complete and implemented! [/h3]
[h3]UI: 50% - Bro... [/h3]

How does one go back 5%? Did I fuckin remove a screen or something? Well, the less funny answer is that I simply didn't do any work on the UI, and while I was working on the Alzuru enemies, I actually found a bug within one of the menus, so now I have even more work to do. Okay, It didn't [i]actually[/i] knock me back 5%, but it's a lot funnier to imagine that I did so little work that the game actually devolved. But no, we're still at around 50% when it comes to the UI.

On a more serious note, [b]I'd like to spend April actually working on some of the incomplete menus.[/b] Since Reminiscent Mode is in a near complete state, I can afford to sink a bunch of time messing up and testing things. 

...Oh, actually, almost forgot, I redid the event screen, and it looks a lot better now. Dark, but it fits the aesthetic. So I guess I actually did make some progress this month. Erm...back up to 55%, I suppose.

As for Achievements, like I said last month, a majority of the achievement rewards are fully functional, though not obtainable in game. There's only about 4 items I have to complete, but I can always do those later. Now, the fun part comes with actually implementing the achievements and making them obtainable.[b] I probably won't focus on it this month,[/b] but it's not a long process, anyway.[b] I could dedicate like a week to that, and I could probably get it done. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/d881b3c87b0116b834669401f3491a767ef4ceea.png[/img]

That's all for the third month! Thank you very much for reading all the way through, and I hope I'll have even more to share in April. See you next month, and I hope you have an 𝒜mazing rest of your day! Hehe.

notes.title: Changes • Revisions
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]


Hey, hello, and hi! Can you believe it, it's already been a month since the last post. Or, something close to it. And in that month, we've had yet another spike of people wish listing the game! Wonder where that came from...Anyway, I would like to once again thank everyone who has this game wish listed, and another extra thanks to anyone reading this right now. Really makes me feel motivated when I see so many people waiting for the release.

How's your guys' month's going? Personally, I set a goal to listen to every MARETU song and then ranked them. I'd definitely recommend him if gritty music is up your alley. And for those of you who already know who he is, Darling and Maegamist are at the top, Girl Eraser is at the bottom. I'm sorry, I don't make the rules, it's just facts.


But anyway! Enough about me, let's talk more about...[i]me[/i] some more! We've got some exciting news this month, so onto the progress!


[h1]Reminiscent • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]30% - Making Changes
[/h2]

This month was mostly spent redoing old assets and thinking up ways to make the mode more fun without having to introduce a bunch of more units. New units will be coming later, like I said before, but still.

For the second problem, I decided on a system that gives old enemies a little more flair than their story mode counterparts. For that, I have decided on Station Passives!

As you progress through the run, enemies now have a chance to gain [b]Station Passives, which are special passives that copy the effects of specific items. [/b] Yes, this means that now your foes can have the same overpowered ass builds that you're running! Every enemy except the final boss can have these.

Each unit has 2 hand-picked passives, but there are 5 universal ones that are unlocked via Steam Achievements.

I still have to tweak their frequency and test them out some more, but some of these combinations are really difficult so far! I was steam rolling most of the game with this one deck, and then I was left with like 15 HP after going against a particularly strong Station Passive combination. 

But enough of that, let's get to the cool stuff. [b]The gray background that you've seen in the trailer has been replaced![/b] I've already started using this thing everywhere, it's replaced some of the screenshots already. Made by the wonderful Owen J, I really do think it's my favorite BG in the game right now. Not to undermine the other ones, but this one is really a league of its own. 

On a smaller note, [b]Griffn's spear has been replaced with a battle-axe.[/b] It's got more personality than the spear, and it fits with the story much better, too. 

I had to spend a bunch of time redoing her Cube Art to fit with the new weapon. Not that I'm complaining, that needed to happen, some were over a year old, they didn't look very good. A big thanks to Qubes for never missing with their character sprites, goddamn.


Definitely changes I should have made before putting up the Steam Page, but whatever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/2ff7269e223d3e8a546ab14e9f96c463b780368e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/c96162595c658eab07be865552a6adf15108a133.png[/img]


[h1]Misc • Progress
[/h1]
[h3]Achievements: 40% - Assets are drawn and complete. [/h3]
[h3]UI: 55% - I feel stuck... [/h3]

Almost all of the Achievement rewards are now in the files. The items have sprites, and the Cubes have Cube Art.
...And that's about it! The next step will be implementing all of their effects, and then after that I can get to making achievements actually obtainable. If I'm not lazy, [b]this really shouldn't take more than two months. [/b]I've already started on some of the items, actually.

However, the meat of it is in the UI. I'm starting to notice that this is not my strong suit. Making something stylish is quite difficult for me, it's eating up more time than I'd like to admit.

I made the character selection screen, credits, and item encyclopedia menus all in one month. How many of these are good looking and fully functional? Zero! So, instead of attaching a screenshot of some WIP menus, I'll just add some gifs showcasing 2 of my favorite completed items, both lore and effect-wise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/25d2409fb07257f260d27db86672840edd665bba.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458265/7f3b4db706535858be17356b666ee0bf6a07d0ac.gif[/img]


That's all for this month! To end on a more positive note, [b]I'm planning to release a demo sometime in June[/b] for the Steam Next Fest. It's still plenty far away, but keep your eyes out peeled for that! Thank you for reading, and I'll see you next month on March 21st!

notes.title: Thank • You!
notes.content:
[h1]Opening • Statement
[/h1]

Hey, hello, and hi! It is I, flower baasket, here for the first monthly devlog for Snow • Fall. For future reference, [b]all following updates will be posted on the 21st of each month.[/b] It just didn't feel right to have radio silence for a month after putting the game up on Steam, so we're a bit early this month.

Before I start, I would like to personally thank everybody that checked out this game on Steam, and an extra thanks if you've Wishlisted it! Having a game on Steam is a bit surreal, to be honest, but it's all super exciting! I hope we can have plenty more devlogs in the future. 

Well, with all of that boring stuff out of way, let's get into the progress! Yipee!



[h1]Story • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]100% - Fully complete![/h2]

Starting off with some good news! All of the enemies, items, music, and story for the first chapter were already done before I even had this game on Steam. I just had a little polishing to do, and that was it. This is the only chapter that will be available on launch, by the way.

I would like to announce that [b]the first chapter will be releasing with 43 base items, 45 base Cubes (or cards), and a whole lotta lore, sometime in August![/b] More items and Cubes can be unlocked via Steam Achievements, but that's a different section, I'll get to that later. I do hope that you'll enjoy Mika Side Story - Severance when it releases. I put a lot of effort into ensuring a good story. I'm not quite sure if it paid off, but there's only one way to tell.

[h1]Reminiscent • Progress
[/h1]
[h2]10% - Not-so fully complete![/h2]

Reminiscent Mode is a more traditional roguelike experience, a semi-infinite mode in which you fight against enemies that you've already seen in the story. No cutscenes, no important dialogue, just 15 nodes of pure action. The final node is a random, Reminiscent exclusive boss, and after that you can either choose to quit the run there or keep going infinitely.

I'm realizing that only having enemies you've seen in the story isn't really enough content. There's only one chapter, after all, so there's not going to much much diversity. I'll probably add some Reminiscent exclusive units later on.

As for progress, I've hardly done anything on this mode. I've got the enemy randomization working, and  we're working on replacing the gray background found in the trailer. It's kind of bland looking. Also, notable work is being done on the first boss, Liu Griffn. I finished some of her Cubes, and I'm really proud of how they turned out!
